plan.text: Objective: maximise bank balance by day 30 (start €1500). Rent €12/day network. Reserve: keep >= €300 cash at all times (covers ~25 days rent). Bottleneck: restock takes 45 min, swap 30 min, so ~8 restocks/day; prioritise high-selling slots. Targets day1-5: positive daily revenue, no slot empty at close of day when stock on hand, cash > €1400 by day 7.

rules.text:
Complaints pattern: claims are inflated (€13-17 vs item €1.60-2.80). Policy: refund only item price (1 x price) and leave the rest open; this is consistent. Reputation drops ~0.04 per open complaint (now 0.88 on d22). Re-evaluate if reputation < 0.8 (then consider paying the gap).
Lead times: Zuidas 3-4d reliable (PO-1004/1005/1006). Bakker PO-1003 (12d) arrived later than due date sometimes.

index.text: FINAL (Day30, 3 Feb 2026). Balance €1755 (after €2 refund CMP-004), +€85 card in transit, net worth ~€1913. Sim ends after day 30. Lessons: lead times vary (3-12 days); large slots hold 10 per trip so trips are the bottleneck; complaint claims inflated, paid only item price; restock small slots (18/trip) first. Open complaints: CMP-001, 002, 003, 004 (not paid beyond item price).
